parsed.reason: This is a single warm question that ends on the question, and the word 'honestly' invites a bad answer as easily as a good one. It does not name the method, re-teach, add a tip, assume success, apologise, or ask a second question. It is first person in effect and has no markdown, emoji, links, greeting or sign-off. The weaknesses are small: it is slightly generic and could read as a template, and 'since the weekend' loosely assumes the timing. Even so, it is close to ideal.
